documentation.content: A production VPC firewall rule changed. Run `python3 scripts/ops/gcp_public_beta_audit.py` immediately and confirm TCP/80+443 remain limited to the pinned Cloudflare ranges and `gregale-origin` target tag.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: log_id("cloudaudit.googleapis.com/activity") AND resource.type="gce_firewall_rule" AND protoPayload.methodName:("compute.firewalls.insert" OR "compute.firewalls.patch" OR "compute.firewalls.update" OR "compute.firewalls.delete")
